overview: This 1947–1949 file traces efforts to rebuild Japan’s textile industry and exports under the occupation. State Department, SCAP, foreign governments, and industry representatives debated production limits, raw materials, trade allocations, financing, prices, and competition, while arranging purchasing missions and assessing cotton, rayon, silk, and synthetic fibers.
interest: The file reveals how occupation officials weighed Japan’s economic recovery against foreign competition and demands to restrict its textile production.
